about: GTA 6 took 13 years 2 months (GTA V Sept 17 2013 to GTA VI Nov 19 2026, per Rockstar). Not a record: measured from the first release anywhere of one numbered main game to the next, Kingdom Hearts III waited 13y 1m, Psychonauts 2 16y 4m, Shenmue III 18y 2m (launched Nov 19 2019, same calendar day as GTA 6), Streets of Rage 4 26y 1m. Delta, pillar 4. Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.say: G T A six is a thirteen year wait.
And that is not a record.

lines.text: So which famous sequels took longer?

lines.say: Kingdom Hearts three? Thirteen years too.

lines.text: Shenmue's launch day? November 19th. Sound familiar?
lines.say: Shen moo's launch day? November nineteenth. Sound familiar?
And Streets of Rage four? Twenty six years.

lines.text: Almost twice as long as GTA 6.
lines.say: Almost twice as long as G T A six.

lines.text: So, is thirteen years long? Yes or no?
